nominee.longerDescription: Happy WW! 1 WEEK TILL GTA 6!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Let's all say a prayer to the lord for allowing me to get so close to this MONUMENTAL CHAPTER! Anyways lets get back to the topic. This week I have a real fine wine for us, named Simone Kessell who is 51 years old and from New Zealand. I hope at least once in life I can experience being with an older woman! I know her similarly from Yellowjackets like Sophie. Her age "appropriate character"  is quite hot as well (last pic), but Simone just got me barking all the time she was on the screen. Its one of those situations where your body just has a reaction :P Its funny when you are in your mid twenties cause dating a 20 yo and a 51 yo sounds just as fantastic. In the show she is a deeply spiritual person and I was thinking the whole time how easily I would join her silly cult. Hype: 8.5/10
